decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed first and second floor front extensions to the shopping parade, by reason of their size, forward position and appearance, would represent an obtrusive and unsympathetic development, which would unbalance the appearance of the shopping parade and detract from the original character of the building and the street scene, contrary to policy ENV-B.1.1 (New development) of the Council's adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The proposed first and second floor front extensions, by reason of their size, bulk and forward position, would result in unacceptable enclosure and loss of outlook to the adjoining flat to the east, resulting in harm to neighbours' living conditions, contrary to policy ENV-B.1.1 (New development) of the Council's adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 3 - The proposal fails to provide any private amenity space for the new residential accommodation and insufficient details have been provided for the Council to be satisfied that the proposal would comply with the Council's parking and servicing standards, in the interest of pedestrian and highway safety and the satisfactory servicing of the site. The proposal is therefore contrary to policy ENV-B.1.1 (New development), H.4.1 (Housing Standards) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Development) of the Council's adopted Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of first and second floor front extensions to premises and creation of second floor self contained flat to 300 Bath Road.
